hotels.title: Stylish Doha City Stay with Contemporary Arabian Flair
hotels.description: Step into Art Deco elegance on Doha’s Corniche with this five-star retreat, where the Museum of Islamic Art and the National Museum of Qatar are both within easy reach. The hotel’s heritage-inspired interiors pair with a rooftop pool overlooking the city skyline and Arabian Gulf. Dine on international fare at Seasons Restaurant or savour refined Japanese dishes at Sushi Bar. Souq Waqif’s spice-scented lanes, traditional falcon shops and acclaimed Qatari restaurants, including Parisa and Al Terrace, are a short drive away
